name: Enterprise-Wide Network Deployment
tagline: Multi-site LAN/WAN build-out for an oil & gas operator.
description: An enterprise-wide network deployment for Marshall Oil & Gas Services spanning multiple sites. Covered LAN/WAN design with FortiGate and Sophos firewalls, Active Directory, group policies, point-to-point radio links, and fiber backbone. The network ran three years with zero security incidents.
